  • typedef _HxWidget_t HxWidget_t

  • typedef _HxDialog_t HxDialog_t

  • typedef _HxApplicationBar_t HxApplicationBar_t
    HxApplicationBar_t is the data structure used by the Application Bar. See hxapplicationbar.h for the HxApplicationBar_t API.
  • typedef _HxContainer_t HxContainer_t
    HxContainer_h is the data structure used by container objects. Containers are used to group widgets together in a scrollable, show/hide-able pane. See hxconstainer.h for the HxContainer_t API.
  • typedef _HxScrollbar_t HxScrollbar_t
    HxScrollbar_t is the data structure used by Scrollbar objects. See hxscrollbar.h for the HxScrollbar_t API.
  • typedef _HxFont_t HxFont_t
    HxFont_t is the font data structure. The font loading and string measurement API is defined in hxfont.h.
  • typedef _HxCursor_t HxCursor_t
    HxCursor_t is the cursor data structure. The cursor loading and setting APIs are defined in hxcursor.h.
  • typedef _HxMenu_t HxMenu_t
    HxMenu_t is the menu data structure. The menu manipulating API is defined in hxmenu.h.
  • typedef _HxList_t HxList_t
    HxList_t is the list data structure. The list manipulating API is defined in hxlist.h.
  • typedef _HxMenuItem_t HxMenuItem_t
    HxMenuItem_t is the menu item data structure. The menu item manipulating API is defined in hxmenu.h.
  • typedef _HxPinWheel_t HxPinWheel_t
    HxPinWheel_t is the pin wheel data structure. The pin wheel manipulating API is defined in hxpinwheel.h. This is a widget for displaying indeterminate progress.
  • typedef _HxRegion_t HxRegion_t
    HxRegion_t is a data structure used for defining the clipping region when drawing widgets. See hxregion.h for the constructor and accessor functions.

Enumeration Type Documentation

enum HxBlitFlags_t

Constants defining effects for image blitting. These constants can be combined.

Enumerator:
kHxBlitNoFX  Use none of the effects.
kHxBlitBlendAlphaChannel  Enable alpha blending, using the alpha channel from source.
kHxBlitBlendColorAlpha  Enable alpha blending, using the constant alpha value contained within the widget's current color.
kHxBlitColorize  Modulate the source color with the widget's current color.
kHxBlitSrcColorKey  Do not blit pixels matching the source color key.
kHxBlitDstColorKey  Write to the destination only if the destination pixel matches the destination color key.
kHxBlitSrcPremultiply  Modulate the source color with the (modulated) source alpha.
kHxBlitDstPremultiply  Modulate the destination color with the destination alpha.
kHxBlitDemultiply  Divide the color by the alpha value before writing the data to the destination.
kHxBlitDeinterlace  Deinterlace the source during blitting by reading only one field (every second line of the full image), scaling it vertically.
kHxBlitFlagsMask
